effects.note: Card reads 'While using a blunt weapon, gain 10% physical damage bonus.' Modelled as a bonus to Physical Power Bonus, which is the sheet row an item's Physical Damage Bonus is believed to land in — that belief is still unmeasured and is recorded in data/README.md. Community reports also say it applies only to Maces rather than to all Blunt damage.

Card reads 'Gain 15% divine magical damage bonus. When a divine attack is successful, reduce their move speed bonus by 15% for 1 seconds. Does not inflict while on cooldown.' Only the first clause is modelled: the debuff carries a duration, which ADR-014 defers. Modelled as a bonus to Magic Power Bonus on the same unmeasured belief as Blunt Weapon Mastery.

Card reads 'Gain 5% fire magical damage bonus. The duration of applied burns are increased by 2 seconds, and a burned target reduces incoming physical healing by 50% and incoming magical healing by 50% for 4 seconds.' Only the first clause is modelled: burn and the healing reduction both carry a duration, which ADR-014 defers. Modelled as a bonus to Magic Power Bonus on the same unmeasured belief as Blunt Weapon Mastery.
